title: Dead Water
summary: Wren says the harvesters' leaders at the vats never look behind them, because nothing down there ever has. Get behind five, and she'll teach your rogues what she puts on her knives (the rogue's level-12 skill).

steps.journal: Defeat five of the Canal Locks' wave-leaders. At Vat Seven, the third floor, they're the harvesters'.

ready: Tell Wren it's done: tap her party card, then Talk.
done: Wren taught your rogues Venom, and wouldn't say where she learned it.
